task:
Implement the TRANSPORT-AGNOSTIC backend increment of docs/plans/2026-07-16-supabase-membership-provisioning.md (Sections 1-3, backend only). Do NOT do Task 0 (it is a live upstream spike a loop cannot perform) and do NOT wire real upstream write calls. Concretely:

1. Add 'members' to SupabaseCategory in src/supabase/constants.ts.
2. In src/supabase/classify.ts, classify the CONFIRMED public read endpoint GET /v1/organizations/{slug}/members -> action 'supabase:members:list', category 'members', resource 'org:<slug>'. Keep all other org paths on their existing 'organizations' mapping. Deny-by-default (return null) stays for unmapped paths.
3. Create src/supabase/member-schema.ts: a zod schema + parseMemberRequest(body) that normalizes an invite/re-role/assign request into a flat list of assignments { target_email, target_domain, requested_role, requested_project | null }. Validate role is one of Owner|Administrator|Developer|Read-Only. Reject malformed/duplicate assignments.
4. Create src/supabase/member-context.ts: buildMemberContexts(assignments, resource) -> RequestContext[] (one context PER assignment) each with scalar fields supabase.target_email, supabase.target_domain, supabase.requested_role, supabase.requested_project, supabase.batch_size, supabase.contains_production. This lets the EXISTING evaluatePolicy(policy, contexts[]) (which requires ALL contexts to pass) reject the whole batch if any item is impermissible. Do NOT modify the policy engine.
5. Extend src/routes/token-binding.ts validateSupabaseResources so 'supabase:members:*' actions are permitted on a supabase-scoped token; keep account-wide reach (project:* / supabase:account) behind the existing wildcard-token requirement.
6. Document the new supabase.* condition field names in src/policy-types.ts (comment/type only; no engine logic change).

TDD: write failing tests FIRST in test/ (e.g. test/supabase-members.test.ts) for each piece, then implement. Cover deny paths explicitly: Owner denied when policy allows only Developer/Read-Only; out-of-scope project denied; over-max batch denied; one bad item rejects the whole batch (assert authorize returns a non-empty denied[]).

HARD CONSTRAINTS: Do NOT weaken, skip, or delete any existing test. Do NOT edit scripts/api-coverage or its fixtures (member writes are not in the public OpenAPI spec, so they must not appear in the coverage snapshot). Do NOT add real fetch() calls to the Supabase internal API - upstream write wiring is deferred to the plan's Task 0. Run prettier so `bun run lint` passes.
